title: 'You are not alone': Pope hits out at jails in closed-off Equatorial Guinea
summary: Pope Leo XIV on Wednesday made a tightly controlled visit to a notorious prison in Equatorial Guinea's biggest city, after launching a rare criticism of living conditions for inmates.
